description: This Java class models a credit card embedded entity in an e-commerce application. It uses JPA annotations for ORM mapping to a database table, encapsulating credit card details like type, owner, number, expiration date, and CVV. The class provides getter and setter methods for each attribute.

classes.name: CreditCard
classes.description: A JPA embeddable class representing credit card details associated with a payment process in an e-commerce system.

methods.name: getCcOwner
methods.description: Returns the name of the credit card owner.

methods.name: setCcOwner
methods.description: Sets the name of the credit card owner.

methods.name: getCcExpires
methods.description: Returns the credit card expiration date.

methods.name: setCcExpires
methods.description: Sets the credit card expiration date.
